A `break`, `continue`, `give` or `fall` carries the state where it stands, through the `defer`s the emitter runs at the jump, to the frame it lands in, and FLOW-001 asks that same walk whether a road reaches a function's or a value arm's end: a move or a rewrite on a road that leaves (DEF-429), a labelled `break` or one held in an expression that silenced FLOW-001 (DEF-436, DEF-548), a `while` condition walked once (DEF-538), an inner loop sampled for one trip (DEF-546) and a bare `continue` in a condition (DEF-547) are refused where the wrong read stands. A jump's road past the walk's depth is ASSIGN-003 at the jump, `when`'s `then` and `end` grant nothing, and a `pass` or `return` in a `defer` body is TYPE-040 where it trapped the compiler (DEF-417's open half). 177d2b's prices `pf1`, `pg1`, `pd1`, `pd2`, `pd3` go. An assignment's target runs before its value, and while the value runs the names the target read stand still: the value moving or freeing one is MOVE-001 or MOVE-002 where it does so, and assigning or `$$m`-claiming one is the new ASSIGN-005 unless it's an inline array or struct that can't drop (DEF-571); a compound reads its name (DEF-572). THE RULE STANDS FOR WHAT THE VALUE DOES BY NAME. It says nothing of a pointer a call returned with `@l` handed to a callee (DEF-575, `k3b`) or a `Self->` receiver into a `List`'s buffer (DEF-580, `mr1`), both HIGH by kind, on main, at 177d2b3; nor of a `wild` name read as an operand and freed by a later one (DEF-574, `rt1`), or a `wild` pointee freed through an alias or a no-drop holder (DEF-579, `sb3`, `nl4a`). WHY THIS ONE WALK. The ruling, whole (`MANAGEMENT/briefs/177d-held-rulings-2026-11-02.md`, "THE LIST LANDS AS 177d2b2"): the list lands as its own landing right after 177d2b, replaces the small fixes for DEF-429, DEF-436 and DEF-538, closes DEF-546, DEF-547, DEF-548 and DEF-417's open half, takes away DEF-437's and DEF-535's prices, nothing rides, and it's reviewed on its 405 lines and not its net. The small fixes had failed on attack: each was a merge patched where a road met it, and DEF-546, DEF-547, DEF-548 were found against them. So the move walk now keeps a road per state (`AssignState.dead`): a jump takes its state through the `defer` bodies the emitter runs at that jump and lands it in the frame it branches to (`road_out`, `leave_to`, `leave_arm`), a loop's head is one silent trip, `loop_trip`, and each channel a jump stamped during that trip is met with the back road (`widen_roads`). `stmt_exits`, `stmt_completes`, `stmt_has_break`, `assign_loop_body` and `give_road_note` are deleted. Its premises stand in the source, in the comment that opens "WHETHER A STATEMENT LEAVES, COMPLETES OR HOLDS A `break` IS THE WALK'S OWN ANSWER" (`bindings.npk`), where the next person to change the walk reads them. ROWS 5 AND 6 CAME LATER, BY RULING, from reading the walk's own order against the emitter: `emit_assign` forms the target's address, runs the value, then stores, a compound loading the old value before its value, and the walk read the value first. The re-ask of the target after the value failed five ways in 80 minutes, each on measurement (root-only, kept names, the guard, the guard deleted, the guard restored), because asking after the value about a state the value can repair is the wrong question, and management_22 ruled the stand-still rule in its place (the rulings file, "THE TARGET'S NAMES STAND STILL"). The rule only refuses, each price has a one-line remedy, and no independent read was taken for it: the fresh attack was the independent read, with the rule its named target.

DEF-423, THE MECHANISM. The rule as built, road by road, is on the row's dated note. Here the shape. THE CONTEXT: `null_ctx` (`ExprTyper`), set by a slot before it types its value and passed through only the transparent kinds (`null_ctx_passes`): 1 a store, a `pass` or `return` in a `wild`-returning function, a call's `wild` parameter; 4 a sigil builtin's pointer operand and `atomic_from_ptr`'s, which leaves `NULL` to its own rule; 3 a cast's operand and a comparison's against a wild pointer, which admits `NULL` and judges nothing (`null_ctx_of_quals(...) * 3` at the cast, `null_ctx_against` at the comparison); 2 a comparison against a plain one, on both operands now (the binary arm sets the left under `==`, `!=`). `door_role` and `door_count` beside it carry W3's slot, set in `type_builtin_regular`'s argument loop, reset with the context. `give_ctx` carries a pick expression's context to its `give`s alone (`type_pick_expr` over `type_pick_expr_arms`, `type_give_operand`), so its selector, guards and other statements are no value of the slot. THE JUDGE: `type_of_expr` computes `judged` (the node stops the context), types the node, and calls `wild_door(e, id, t, nsaved, rsaved)` after `exprtypes_set`. Contexts 2 and 3 return at once; 1 and 4 ask `door_gated` on the value's type alone (a pointer, a slice, or an array, `Optional` or `Result` of one, fuel 8, the walk's end answering by the kind it stopped on), then `door_wild`, then `door_header_admits`, and push the id to `ExprTypes.door`; context 0 is W4's half, `@` of a `wild` slot whose own type passes the gate. A `wild` receiver is judged in `type_method_call`: a gated value as a value, any other `Self->` receiver by where its address lands (`door_place_step`). THE REPORT: `escape_report_door`, called once from the driver after `escape_walk`, one `BORROW_WILD_STORE` per id. A body typed once marks once; the population's 532 door and TYPE-106 reports held 0 duplicates in one file. PROVENANCE: `door_wild` beside `expr_wild_provenance`, whose readers (TYPE-032, TYPE-097, `b.ptr != NULL`, the emitter's store, TYPE-104's walk) keep their answers; depth 16, closed at its end. `door_call_wild` reads the declaration the call resolved to, an identifier's through its symbol, a method's through `exprtypes_callee`; a function value says nothing and is closed; the `mcpy` family answers by its destination, a destination the door admitted as a header's `.ptr` being no wild block. `door_place_step`: the last dereference on the path decides. DEF-416, THE MECHANISM (type_stmt.npk +135, type_expr.npk +23/−11, type_codes.npk +1; +107, +13/−8, +1 at build 7). THE RULE (management_11, 2026-11-01 01:53 EST; management_12's widening of 05:42:19; the reference's sentence on the row): a `move` whose path contains a plain pointer or non-wild view is refused unless a `wild` step lies after every such step; a `move` through `wild` is then refused if the path's root, or the origin of ANY pointer or view on the path, is a value binding of the same function or is visibly derived from one there (by `@`, field projection, copy or cast), or if that origin cannot be decided. THE WALK, `move_path_verdict(e, id, fuel)` → 0 / 1 / 2: it steps a member, an index, a dereference and the two casts from the moved place towards its root; at each pointer, handle or view base it asks `step_wild` (the slot's qualifier through `place_wild`, or -- the qualifier not being part of the type -- a `#wild_slice`/`#ptr_add`/`#wild_ptr` result, a wild cast, an allocating call, read through a LOCAL's initialiser unless the local is re-assigned anywhere in the function: q9); a plain step answers 1; a wild step asks `ptr_from_outside(e, x, fuel)` -- a pointer PARAMETER, a module binding, `NULL`/`NIL`, an allocating builtin by sigil or by name, a user function declaring a `wild` return when EVERY argument that can carry an address is itself from outside (F1 as narrowed at build 8: `expr_wild_provenance`, then `arg_can_carry_address` -- `type_holds_address` of the argument's type, an untyped argument carries -- over each VALUE argument with the fuel split `(fuel - 1) / argc` over their count, the closed direction when it runs out; a `CallExpr` window holds its turbofish TYPES first, so the loop starts at `expr_generic_count(n)` -- build 9, item 1 of 23:37:38: build 8 read the window from index 0, judged a type's index as an expression and refused 127 of 400 legal generic allocators by the luck of their numbering (`tf_gen.py`); `rh3a`, `rh3d`, `rh3e` and 0 of 400 legal on build 9, `rc3f4`, `rc3f5` refused by their real argument), a bare `ptr_add`/`wild_slice`/`wild_ptr`/`mcpy`/`memset`/`mmov`/`ralloc` by its FIRST VALUE argument (`builtin_answers_by_arg`, the bare-call arm and the sigil arm alike, each starting past the generics, an arity short of one value argument answering false), a member or index through its base, a cast, `move`/`raw`, a local through its initialiser -- which records every key it visits (a local's symbol, a member's name minus the base) so a later store taints it (q1, q6, q7); a `no` or an undecidable origin answers 2, and a builtin's or a call's result whose origin was judged ENDS the walk at 0 (F2, `move_path_place_kind`). THE STORES, (b): `note_ptr_store(e, tgt, val)` at every assignment (`check_assign`), initialiser, `@w` and `$$m w` of a pointer slot (q4) records the target's key as TAINTED when the value is this frame's own (`ptr_from_outside` false) or undecidable, into the typer's `ptr_tainted`/`ptr_keys`/`ptr_vals` lists, truncated per function; the move arm pushes its site (key 0) and `check_function`'s end runs the fixpoint and the judgment, so a store AFTER the move in text order reports at the move (q1, q6, q7, al6, al7, pa10). THE PASS ROAD: `refuse_pass_of_pointee_owned` (type_expr.npk) RECORDS a `PassSite { id, ty, at }` in the typer's `pass_sites` list in place of `place_root`'s pointer test, and `check_function`'s end, after the fixpoint over the move sites, runs `judge_pass_site` on each -- the same walker -- so `pass (<-p).s`, `pass <-p`, `pass (<-(raw idp(p)))`, `return Result{value: <-pa}` (DEF-371's one road) and `pass (<-(#ptr_add over own))` are `NITPICK-TYPE-047` at the `pass`, a store into the pointer slot after the `pass` in text order included (`rc5f_pass_store_mcpy`; build 8, management_13's item 3); a verdict of 0 passes; the message names the vacant slot (D-225), the owner's next read that no rule judges (D-183, DEF-416), and the roads out: a view, an explicit `.clone()`, or a move through the name that owns it. THE EXEMPTIONS: a copy (`type_owns_for_move`: the copy-typed element or field, `m7`, `k1`), a `pure` body's own refusal (one report), a `wild`-qualified PARAMETER root (`r416b_wild_param`: the caller's `(@h) =>! wild` is the assertion, D-019, and the caller need not write it -- DEF-423's row), the declared-unchecked cast at the one expression (`m14`, `m14b`, `i4`, `i5`: the cast asserts the pointee is the author's, D-095), `NULL` as an initialiser (`m13b`: a sentinel is no storage; the later store is judged). WHAT F1 TRUSTED AT BUILD 7, AND WHAT BUILD 8 CLOSED: a declared `wild` return was an origin whatever its arguments -- `func:lie = wild string->(string->:q) { pass (q =>! wild string->); }` and `move(<-(raw lie(@o)))` accepted (u1–u3, 65 on 177a and on build 7), the record calling the callee's own `=>!` the one trust F1 added; review A's finding 6 showed `func:lie2 = wild H->(wild H->:q) { pass q; }` with `move((<-(raw lie2(@h))).s)`, no `=>!` anywhere, 60 on both (`rc3a`, `rc3b`, `rc3d`). Build 8's argument rule refuses them all (u1–u3, `rc3a`–`rc3e`, `rc3g`, `rb4c`, `rc7e` TYPE-104), keeps `rc3h`/`rc3i`/`u4` legal (an outside pointer, or no pointer, among the arguments), and the trust left to a callee's own `=>!` is over arguments from outside only, `i4`'s assertion on a plain parameter. WHAT IT DOES NOT REACH is DEF-423's row: a `wild` parameter taking a plain `@local` with no cast at the call, and a builtin over a plain pointer parameter inside the callee (`ra5a`, `ra5b`, `rc1b`, legal, named beside `i4`); and, wider at build 9 (item 6; review A's finding 1), an address copied into an INTEGER or an outside block by `mcpy` -- `arg_can_carry_address` reads an `int64` as holding no pointer (`type_holds_address`, `TY_INT` false), `note_ptr_store` ignores a key that is not a pointer, and the integer road registered on 177a (`re1`, `re2`) is cast-only, so `at(a)` over an `int64:a` filled by `mcpy(@a, @p, 8i64)` is an origin and `func:at = wild H->(int64:a) never fails { pass #wild_ptr<H>(a); }` hands the frame's address back (`rh1a`–`rh1d` 60 on 177a and build 9; `rh1c` with no `#` and no `=>!` anywhere) -- and two owners of one body by `mcpy(@a, @b, 16i64)`, `mmov` or a `memset` over plain `@local` strings (`rh4a`–`rh4e` 74, the trap once the drops run; `rh5a`–`rh5d`: the laundered header reads 66 or 60 with no drop); the row's options must cover both. HOW F2 FAILS: it ends a path only after `ptr_from_outside` said yes, so an own-rooted `#ptr_add<T>(v.items, i)` (`v` a value binding, `pa7`) is still 2 and `#wild_slice<T>(@arr =>! wild T->, n)` is still 2. HOW THE ARGUMENT RULE FAILS: by its fuel -- a chain of about six `wild`-returning calls with two or more pointer arguments exhausts it (64 → 31 → 15 → 7 → 3 → 1 → 0) and the walk fails closed, TYPE-104 on a legal program (`rc3j`, `rc3k`, `rc3l`; ruled (a) at 21:12:38, the post-180 list; before the split the walk was exponential, `rc3j` 11.18 s at 20 levels, `out_b8/rev/rc3j_pre.time`, about 3 hours at 30 by management's arithmetic); and the string exemption management's sentence allowed ("outside or holds no pointer": a string holds one) was deleted on a count of 0 sites saved (the tree's `wild`-returning functions over a by-value string, `tests/backend/programs/std_fds_closed.npk:21` and `lib/nfs.npk:61`, both `wild int8->`, on no move path; `rc3s3` refused), closed wins. `TYPE_MOVE_THROUGH_POINTER` (type_codes.npk) = `NITPICK-TYPE-104`; a test asserts it (`check_codes_tested`).

NOW: A PLAIN ADDRESS INTO A `List` ELEMENT IS A VIEW-LIKE PARTY. A new party kind `PARTY_ELEM_ADDR` (= 5, after `PARTY_LENT` = 4), raised by `party_kind_of` where an `@place` addresses a `List` element: `place_is_list_element` walks the addressed place (a `BORROW_FUEL` loop, counted) and answers true at an index whose base is a `List` (`type_is_list` on the base's type, `use "../type_layout.npk".*;` added for it), descending through a member access, a safe-nav and a deref, and answers false for a fixed array or a slice (whose storage does not move -- the control u304h). The kind is VIEW-LIKE: `conflicts` places it in the VIEW/SHARED/LENT group (conflicting with `WRITE|EXCLUSIVE`), `summary_judged` includes it, and `check_access_reported` routes it -- before the `PARTY_VIEW` arm -- to `report_elem_addr_conflict` (modelled on `report_view_conflict`, code `BORROW-015` the view's, a tailored sentence). So it is judged by the MUTATION-SUMMARY path (`check_written` -> `CHECK_VIEWS`) exactly as the view party is: a reallocating operation on `l` is a write-capable access of `l`'s storage, and the live `PARTY_ELEM_ADDR` rooted at `l` conflicts with it; `l[i]` canonicalises to `l.items[…]` (D-314 §2), so the party overlaps the operation's write of `l.items`. `party_word` gains its arm; five `PARTY_PLAIN` sites (the non-local assign, the named-root `admit_value`, the `acc_call` claim loop, the ordinary-arg loop and the final claim recheck) guard `PARTY_ELEM_ADDR` like `PLAIN`; `prescan_party` pushes it with `root_ptr:false` and `register_holder` makes it live for all kinds, so the pointer-exemption never applies. THE STORAGE A SLICE VIEWS WHEN NO RANGE NAMES IT IS READ OFF ITS REFS (DEF-297, DEF-301; the plan's M2, `wt/44a/.internal/DEF297_301_PLAN.md`): `escape_slice_targets` (escape.npk) answers, for a slice value -- a slice local, a struct's slice field, a range of either, a call's result, a ternary's or a `pick`'s arms -- the refs `collect_view_refs` carries (a slice local's or a struct's chain through the identifier arm, a call's result by rule A) that may be the run it views, typed at the end of each ref's path (`escape_ref_is_run_of`, `escape_path_end_type`, `escape_type_may_hold_run`: an array, a slice or a `List` of the slice's element, or storage that may hold one; a run carried transitively counts too -- more targets, never fewer; a ref rooted nowhere, a `wild` slice's or an allocator's, gives none, D-315, D-361). THE SUMMARY: a callee's write through a slice local or field over its parameter's run (`t = sl; t[0i64].o = v`) is a write of that parameter's storage (`record_mut_through_slice`), and a slice argument no place names hands the callee's writes to each parameter-rooted target (`record_mut_of_slice_targets`), each target's WHOLE extent (`target_whole_path`). **Cycle 1.2 is COMPLETE** (`meta/roadmap/done/1.2/`): drops are live for
strings, structs, enums, `dyn` (which owns a heap cell and drops through
the vtable's slot 0) and arenas, in sync AND async bodies (frame-resident
flags; the wind-up unwind drops too, and the first test to drive a wind-up
found the rouse and the grace-wait defects). Channels reclaim at their
creating function's exit — `StaleHandle` is reachable, slots reuse under
moved generations — and OWNING elements cross channels under the heap's
first futex mutex, with `move` required at the send. A factory says
`gives` after its parameter list (1.2.6): the caller's exit then owns the
returned channels' reclaim, and creating a channel in an unmarked
channel-returning function refuses. A failed `send` drops its element —
the rule a failing callee already applies to its `move` parameters. Owning elements in ARENAS
refuse at `arena_make` until the generated deep-view family lands (D-183).

**The decisions this cycle settled: D-224…D-233.** `exit` is process exit in
every body (D-224); declared-uninitialised managed storage holds its canonical
vacant value (D-225 — `OwnedFd`'s vacant is −1, not zero); the index type
follows the count (D-226); **a memoised layout fact is never read before it is
computed** (D-227 — the query ensures, the caller does not remember, and
`_recorded` is the explicit opt-out); the orchestration rules are normative
(D-228); the diagnostic walk is generic and borrowing and prints span-sorted
(D-229); D-044's flag types get implemented as one `TY_FLAGS` kind (D-230);
the sub-byte integer widths are struck and the wide ladder pinned (D-231);
and **D-233 replaced Astrée with LLVM-native analyzers over our own emitted
IR**, striking the C emitter (D-232, superseded).
**Four defects came out of D-227's neighbourhood, none found by a test of the
thing that broke**: `tt_grow` never zeroed two of its four side arrays (latent
since 1.2.5); the three memoised bits were read before computation, disabling
TYPE-046, D-215 and `gives` wherever the window was open; a payload-less enum's
bits were never written at all; and two live TYPE-046 violations in `src/`
itself, where a `PlaceVal` owning a string was copied into a consuming
parameter. All four share one root — **a fact that is ABSENT and a fact that is
FALSE were spelled the same way**, which is what the new `absent-fact` harness
stage now makes impossible to reintroduce.

**A concurrency test runs 40 times, not once.** `// stress: N` in a program makes
the harness require the same exit code every run. Two serious defects hid behind
single green runs — `npk_exit` calling `exit` rather than `exit_group`, so a
threaded program's status was whichever thread finished last, and a channel wake
landing between registering and sleeping, which the sleeper-push then erased.
Neither reproduced in fewer than about twenty runs.

`tools/check.npk` still runs the whole frontend over a program and exits 0 on a
clean one — Phase A's checker, now one thin `main` over the shared pipeline.

It refuses a program that returns a borrow, launders one through a call, reads an
unassigned binding, writes a `fixed` binding twice, uses a moved-from binding,
double-frees, takes the address of a temporary, leaves a `pick` arm uncovered, lets
`(*)` swallow ERR, reads a tainted `Result.value`, acquires a lock downward, expands
a macro without bound, names something in a macro body its defining scope does not
have, splices a body where it does not fit, evaluates a `comptime` that never
finishes, derives a trait that cannot be derived, writes a struct literal that
omits a field, discards a `Result` with a bare `f();`, lets a `never fails`
function `fail`/`relay`, drops a trait's `never fails` in an impl, or `fail`s
inside a `defer` (D-163, 1.1.0) — each with its own code, its own span, and a
case in one of the six rejection suites showing it refuse.

**Two dozen whole-tree checks run on every harness invocation** and each found
something on its first run: `check_kinds_typed` (every expression kind is typed),
`check_kinds_lowered_or_refused` (every Expr/Stmt/Decl kind lowers, refuses by
name, or is confessed — plus the LIVE-1 carrier accessors stay read; its first
run found five expression kinds dying as internal defects), `check_codes_tested`
(every code has a case, or a stated reason), `check_codes_centralised` (no code
literal outside a `*_codes.npk`), `check_ll_types_agree` (`// ll:` markers match
the lowering), `check_runtime_sigs_agree` (npkrt.ll vs seed vs
the ir_runtime table BUILTIN_REFERENCE now generates — the spec in the loop
since 1.4.2, and its derived-inner leg found dead on the day it was fixed),
`check_builtin_sig_texts` (every type text the generated signature table hands
the checker is one `builtin_text_type` can intern, and no arm of it is dead —
it caught a half-done `wildx any->` on its first run), and
`check_zero_dependency` (the undefined-symbol scan). A ninth,
`check_decisions_current`, REPORTS rather than fails: stale decision-log
candidates print on every full run for the doc-sync pass. They diff the compiler
against the thing that describes it, which is how cycle 0.6 found every one of
its holes — none was found by a test.
